content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to connect [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] flexible using [product_name] flexible Runtime on a PC, without a panel. I've referenced a connection guide ([document]) and an online video for setup, but connection was unsuccessful. I would appreciate any advice; I've attached screenshots of [product_name] and [product_name] flexible.
It appears the communication isn't working because the [product_name] PC and the [product_name] aren't on the same IP subnet. Please see the attachment—both devices should share the same subnet.
I've used [product_name] flexible Runtime without a panel. In my experience, the IP configuration is not the main issue here.

I set up a small project following official guidance from [company_name]. It works as expected. The runtime station's IP is that of my PC, and both it and the [product_name] are on the same subnet. Perhaps this information will be helpful.
Your thinking is incorrect, since using a real panel or [product_name] flexible Runtime both require the physical network layer. As [user_name] mentioned, devices must be in the same subnet.

The IP addresses for my computer and [product_name] are set correctly. I've configured the [product_name]ONLINE access point in the Set PG / PC Interface settings. Despite this, [product_name] flexible still cannot connect to [product_name].
Hello, can you specify which version of [product_name] you are using? The order number and firmware version would be useful.
Please upload your [product_name] program and [product_name] flexible project as a ZIP archive.

Unfortunately, I cannot open your [product_name] flexible project. My version is [product_name] flexible 2008 SP5 Update 1, while yours is SP3. Attempting to load your project causes [product_name] flexible to crash with an error message.
I am able to upload screenshots of tags, communications, and screens.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces challenges connecting a [product_name] [version_no] to [product_name] flexible Runtime on a PC without a panel. Despite following official guides and verifying correct IP subnet configuration, the connection is not working. Discussions center on network setup and access points, but the user's hope for seamless connectivity via PC remains unfulfilled.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for an easy and dependable setup for connecting [product_name] to [product_name] flexible Runtime on a PC, without needing a panel or dealing with intricate networking problems.
